cohort: A neonate with congenital hyperinsulinism and his father with mild CHI-compatible features.
finding: Monoallelic KCNJ11 readthrough variants, specifically a mutant KCNJ11 protein containing 93 additional amino acids at the C-terminus, likely exert dominant-negative effects on the wildtype protein and constitute a rare etiology of congenital hyperinsulinism.
